payload.summary: CP-HARDEN-02 claimed through the transactional inbox; raw lanes verified and implementation design started from current main.
payload.next_action: Implement resource-level conflict locks, validation and inbox race tests on a bounded branch; do not overlap Windows Legacy.
decisions: Resource conflicts must be checked across lanes independently of work_item identity.
Lock ownership must survive REVIEW_REQUIRED/rework and release only when the claim is released or accepted.
Inbox processing remains the serialized operational mutation authority.
